error_behavior.401: Auth failure. Stop, report 'auth failed', do not retry. Human intervention required.
error_behavior.403: Forbidden. Same as 401: stop and report.
error_behavior.404: Path or repo not found. Log as missing, continue other paths, report at end.
error_behavior.incomplete_batch: If any file in a batch fails verification, the whole batch is held. No partial pickup.
error_behavior.response_size_limit: 1MB per file (matches existing queue response cap). Larger files are logged as oversize and skipped, not truncated.
error_behavior.retry_policy: 3 bounded retries with backoff on 5xx/network errors only. 4xx errors never retried.

existing_pickup_locations: Cron worker instructions: ~/workspace/goals/medic-gpt-automated-loop/crons/minutely/shared-repo-mailbox-watch__interval@10m.md (steps 2-4: git ls-remote, git fetch, git log/diff/show, git ls-tree)
Pulse check: ~/workspace/laptop-agent/pulse-check.py (git log for last-activity timestamps)
Persisted cursor: ~/workspace/goals/medic-gpt-automated-loop/hidden_files/mailbox-watch-state.json (ref SHAs, seen_packets list, thread mtime)

immutable_ref_handling.branch_movement: If branch HEAD moves between listing and read, the read still uses the pinned commit. New HEAD is picked up on the next cycle.
immutable_ref_handling.mismatch: If returned blob SHA != expected SHA, discard the read, log mismatch, do not process. Treat as integrity failure.
immutable_ref_handling.pinning: Resolve branch -> commit SHA once per cycle via GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/commits/{branch}. All file reads in that cycle use ?ref={commit_sha}.
immutable_ref_handling.verification: Each file read returns a blob SHA. Compare against expected SHA from the commit tree before processing.

cursor_and_dedup.changed_content_same_id: If content hash differs from the recorded hash for a seen message_id, flag as 'content changed under same ID' and do not silently replace. Human review required.
cursor_and_dedup.interrupted_processing: If processing is interrupted mid-batch, the cursor is not advanced. Next cycle re-reads from the last committed cursor. Idempotent by design.
cursor_and_dedup.persisted_cursor: Extend mailbox-watch-state.json with per-repo cursors: {repo: {last_commit_sha, seen_blob_shas: [...]}}. Written atomically (write-temp-then-rename) after each successful cycle.
cursor_and_dedup.receipt_only: Receipt packets are recorded in seen lists but never trigger substantive processing. Same as current behavior.

test_matrix.note: All tests offline/synthetic. No repo writes, no visibility changes.
tests: T1: read_path with valid repo/path/ref returns correct content and matching blob SHA
T2: read_path with wrong ref returns 404, raises ReadError, no retry
T3: read_path with revoked auth returns 401, stops immediately, no retry
T4: branch moves between pin and read; read still uses pinned commit, returns old content
T5: blob SHA mismatch (tampered response) discards read, logs integrity failure
T6: oversize file (>1MB) is skipped with oversize log, not truncated
T7: interrupted batch does not advance cursor; next cycle re-reads cleanly
T8: duplicate message_id with changed content is flagged, not silently replaced
